name: io.github.Servosity/abnormal-mcp
title: Abnormal Security MCP
description: Abnormal Security email threats, cases, and reporting in your terminal and your AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: ABNORMAL_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the ABNORMAL_API_TOKEN credential for the Abnormal Security MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: ABNORMAL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Abnormal Security API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: ABNORMAL_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: ABNORMAL_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API instead of the local store.

environmentVariables.name: ABNORMAL_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Abnormal Security requests.

environmentVariables.name: ABNORMAL_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
